fields.description: Golf Acres offers one- to three-bedroom apartments and three-bedroom townhouses within Emaar South. Apartments rise above a podium, while the townhouse plans provide two-level homes with garden-access terraces. Earthy colours, landscaped outdoor spaces and a golf-course setting give the development its character.

overview: The brochure emphasises shared outdoor life around the pool, gardens and barbecue spaces. Within the wider community, it identifies a golf clubhouse, retail plaza, dining, play areas and event spaces. These neighbourhood facilities should be checked for access terms and operating dates; they are not a promise of private golf membership with a home.
research.locationNote: Golf Acres is in Emaar South within Dubai South. Emaar identifies Golf Views, Golf Point and Urbana III nearby. Check the selected unit’s position, orientation and actual route to everyday destinations rather than relying on promotional drive-time estimates.
research.priceNote: Emaar displays AED 4,727,888 for its advertised selection and retains AED 950,000 in its launch key facts. The fact sheet lists category starts of AED 950,000, AED 1.75m and AED 2.49m for one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, and AED 4.04m for townhouses. Property Finder shows a sold-out label and separate resale listings. Confirm the current unit price and availability directly.
research.paymentNote: Reported launch terms are 10% booking, 70% during construction and 20% on completion. The dated stages below come from indexed launch-document text; the source PDF could not be reopened visually. Obtain the current signed schedule before relying on these historic dates.
research.handoverNote: December 2028 is the reported estimated completion, corroborated by Property Finder. Current progress and contractual delivery require confirmation.

facts.label: Published mix
facts.value: The launch sheet lists 158 homes: 68 one-bedroom, 49 two-bedroom and 31 three-bedroom apartments, plus ten townhouses. These are total counts, not remaining stock.

facts.label: Townhouse Type 1
facts.value: TH01 has one bedroom, a maid’s room and bathroom, laundry and a garden-access terrace downstairs. Two bedrooms, a store, walk-in wardrobe and balcony are upstairs.

facts.label: Area definition
facts.value: Apartment totals include balconies. Three-bedroom Type 1, for example, separates 1,550.11 sq ft suite from 705.04 sq ft balcony. The range above uses floor-plan total areas, not the fact sheet’s ambiguous plot-area heading.
